Based on order_line data grouped by customer (party) and quarter of `sold_at`, using cumulative-sum diffing (Q1 = sum as of 2025-03-31, Q2 = sum as of 2025-06-30 minus Q1, Q3 = sum as of 2025-09-30 minus Q1+Q2, Q4 = sum as of 2025-12-31 minus Q1-Q3, and 2026 = all-time sum minus 2025 full-year sum), I checked all 258 customers who bought anything in 2025.

Only two customers bought in every one of the four 2025 calendar quarters (Q1: Jan–Mar, Q2: Apr–Jun, Q3: Jul–Sep, Q4: Oct–Dec) and show zero purchase quantity in 2026:

- **Ana Lund** (party:8886536c) — Q1: 16 units, Q2: 14, Q3: 13, Q4: 14 (2025 total 57 units, 57 order lines); 2026: 0 units, 0 order lines.
- **Cara Novak** (party:8b1f5466) — Q1: 2 units, Q2: 2, Q3: 3, Q4: 3 (2025 total 10 units, 10 order lines); 2026: 0 units, 0 order lines.

Basis: order_line.qty summed by order_line.sold_at (calendar quarters, not the accounting/operations week convention), traced through order_line.of_order → order.placed_by, using the dataset as exported 2026-07-01, which contains sold_at data only through 2026 Q2 (no Q3/Q4 2026 rows exist yet in this system, so "not bought in 2026" here means "no purchases recorded for 2026 H1"). If your intent is a full-year 2026 check, this dataset can't yet support that since 2026 H2 hasn't been captured.

ANSWER: Two customers bought in all four calendar quarters of 2025 and have zero recorded purchases in 2026 (through the data's 2026 H1 cutoff): Ana Lund and Cara Novak. No other customer satisfies both conditions.
